About

My research focuses on large language models: retrieval-augmented generation for legal documents, domain-specific fine-tuning, and synthetic data for low-resource tasks. At CodePresso I build LLM-based agents for automatic assessment content generation, code scoring, and code-interview analysis.

Research interests

  • Large Language Models
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation
  • Parameter-efficient fine-tuning
  • Synthetic data
  • AI Agents
